claude.sample_unit: LLM-generated and rewritten patient education materials

links.outcome: Readability (SMOG, FKGL) of LLM-generated PEMs versus 6th-grade target
links.effect: Only ChatGPT-4 generated PEMs at the specified 6th-grade reading level (SMOG 5.5 ± 0.6, FKGL 5.6 ± 0.7); ChatGPT-3.5 and Bard did not.
links.quote: Only ChatGPT-4 was able to generate PEMs at the specified 6th-grade reading level (SMOG: 5.5 ± 0.6, FKGL: 5.6 ± 0.7).

links.outcome: Readability, quality and accuracy of PEMs rewritten to plain language by LLMs
links.effect: ChatGPT-4 rewrote published PEMs to below 6th-grade level (SMOG 5.6 ± 0.6, FKGL 5.7 ± 0.8, p<0.001) without decrease in quality (DISCERN ≥4) or accuracy (Likert misinformation = 1).
links.quote: Original published PEMs were rewritten to below a 6th-grade reading level with Prompt C, without a decrease in quality, understandability, or accuracy only by ChatGPT-4 (SMOG: 5.6 ± 0.6, FKGL: 5.7 ± 0.8, p < 0.001, DISCERN ≥4, Likert misinformation = 1).

unlisted_practices: Prompting LLMs with an explicit reading-level target and readability formula to improve readability of patient education materials
